questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the brightest star in the night sky?
A. Sirius
B. Betelgeuse
C. Polaris
Answer: A.
questions.de: Welcher ist der hellste Stern am Nachthimmel?
questions.en: What is the brightest star in the night sky?

timeline.labelEn: Earliest recorded use of the name Sirius, in Hesiod's Works and Days (7th century BC)
timeline.labelDe: Früheste überlieferte Verwendung des Namens Sirius, in Hesiods „Werke und Tage“ (7. Jh. v. Chr.)

questions.notes: Options dropped; the question was already open. Apparent magnitude −1.46, almost twice as bright as Canopus.

questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] How does the traditional East Asian age counting system typically work?
A. Age is counted from the date of conception
B. Everyone is considered one year old at birth
C. Age is counted by month first and then by year
Answer: B. In East Asian age reckoning, particularly in traditional Chinese culture, a person is considered to be one year old at birth. On New Year’s Day, everyone adds a year to their age rather than on their individual birthdays.
questions.de: Wie alt ist ein Mensch nach der traditionellen ostasiatischen Altersrechnung bei seiner Geburt?
questions.en: In traditional East Asian age reckoning, how old is a person considered to be at birth?

timeline.labelEn: South Korea switches from traditional East Asian age reckoning to the international age system
timeline.labelDe: Südkorea stellt von der traditionellen ostasiatischen Altersrechnung auf die internationale Zählung um

questions.notes: Age starts at 1 at birth and increases each New Year. South Korea officially switched to the international system on 28 June 2023.
